title: Relation
description: How one observation relates to one event (stance). One line of relations.jsonl. Copying between observations is recorded separately in dependences.jsonl.

annotations.description: One entry per annotator. Kept separately so agreement can be measured.

gold.description: Adjudicated final judgement. Absent until adjudication.

label.description: supports: says it happened and agrees on every attribute it mentions. partially_supports: says it happened but disagrees on at least one attribute. contradicts: denies it happened, or says it is false/rumour. related: about the event but no checkable claim. unrelated: not about this event.

conflicts.description: Attributes on which the observation disagrees with ground truth. Required for partially_supports.

stale.description: True if the item describes the event as it was earlier (outdated when published).
